candidate_semantics: Reuse R2.4 evidence-aware classifier. VOLUME_WAVE is CURRENT only when completed 1D and completed 4H both provide directional evidence in the same direction, or both are TRUE_NEUTRAL. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE contributes zero coverage.
purpose: Validate the fixed R2.4 A_STRICT candidate on an older historical window excluded from the recent R2.4 shadow sample before any production promotion decision.

evaluation.holdout: last 25 percent of extended OOS window

promotion_policy: R2.5 PASS creates a production-promotion candidate only. Main branch and official BASIC OFFICIAL remain unchanged until explicit merge validation.
